title: bug: Bug/UX: Restoring .zip backup shows empty boards until manual hard refresh / re-login
body:
### Describe the bug

When restoring a saved .zip backup (e.g., homarr-backup-2026-07-20.zip) on Homarr v1.75.0, the system completes the restore procedure and confirmation dialog, but then incorrectly reports that no boards are found, showing an empty layout.

The restored data is not rendered immediately, nor is the user prompted to refresh or re-authenticate. Once the user manually reloads the page, they are redirected to the login screen. After logging back in, the restored boards and data appear as expected.

Expected behavior
Upon completing the restore, Homarr should either:

-     Automatically invalidate/refresh the client-side state/cache so the restored boards display immediately without manual intervention, or

-     Explicitly notify the user that the session has changed and automatically redirect them to the login screen (or prompt a re-login) to immediately fetch the updated board data.

System Info

    Homarr Version: 1.75.0

    Backup File: .zip format (homarr-backup-2026-07-20.zip)

### Steps to reproduce

    Go to Settings > Backup & Restore and upload a .zip backup file (e.g., homarr-backup-2026-07-20.zip).

    Accept and confirm the restore warning prompt.

    Wait for the restore procedure to complete.

    Observe: Homarr claims it cannot find any board and displays an empty dashboard.

    Manually reload/refresh the browser page.

    Observe: You are redirected to the login screen. Log in, and the board renders correctly with all restored data intact.

### Impact

At first it looks like restore was not working...But it did.

### Additional information

_No response_

### Version

1.75.0

### Installation method

Docker Compose

### Browser

Firefox

Hey @captainjs — I've opened a fix in https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/pull/6624 that addresses the confusing post-restore behavior (empty board / silent login redirect).

Root cause: Homarr stores sessions in the database, so restoring a backup replaces the DB and invalidates your session. The old flow did a silent page reload, which left you on an empty board until a manual hard refresh.

The PR replaces that with an explicit "Restore Complete — session invalidated" message and auto-redirects you to the sign-in page, where the restored boards render immediately after logging in.

Could you test it with the PR image and confirm?

```yaml
services:
  homarr:
    container_name: homarr
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr-test:pr-6624
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./homarr/appdata:/appdata
    ports:
      - '7575:7575'
```

Then: Settings → Tools → Backup & Restore → restore your `.zip` → you should now see a clear completion message and be sent to the login page instead of an empty board.

(Note: `SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY` must match your existing install's key when mounting your existing `./homarr/appdata` — see the [Docker install docs](https://homarr.dev/docs/getting-started/installation/docker).)
